title: nb init: the pre-push block can fail the code push when nb is missing
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

SPEC (Sync): the pre-push block never fails the code push.

The block (`bin/nb` around line 1031) ends with `[ -x "$NB" ] && { ... }`. When nb is not on PATH and the recorded plugin path no longer exists, that test is the last command and the hook exits 1. A reviewer reproduced exit 1 with the path replaced. Applies when the block is last in the hook.
